title: Class 1 'tetra' objects fly in formations of three to twenty

tellings.quote: Yes, the objects of the first class usually They fly in groups.

plain: The objects that Skywatcher, a startup that says it can summon UFOs, sorts into its "Class 1" or "tetra" category usually fly in formations of three to twenty. James Valor, who speaks for Skywatcher and says he has seen them on the company's operations between 2021 and 2025, tells Michels that "the objects of the first class usually fly in groups." If true, it suggests these objects move in coordinated groups rather than alone.
